description: A dinner party is tomorrow with 6 guests who have various food allergies. Create a safety cross-reference matrix in a spreadsheet showing which dishes are safe for which guests. Input data is provided in /home/ga/Documents/party_planning/guest_allergies.txt. Create the matrix at /home/ga/Documents/party_planning/allergy_matrix.xlsx with guests and dishes clearly labeled, safe/unsafe markings (using colors, symbols, or text), and identify any guests with critically limited options. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
